title: Strings with non-ASCII characters
notes: Non-ASCII printable characters are written as they are or as escapes; either way they read back as the same text. This is a writing convention of the family, not the specification: a string is written plain only when every common reader reads it as that same string, so the text is judged under the YAML 1.2 Core schema (loose) and also under YAML 1.1 and the number forms common readers accept (strict).
